categories_thin: Law firms - only two Manville offices found (Weiss & Weiss; George Frana Jr.). Lawyers register with the state, not the borough, so the official directory has none; most Manville attorneys are solo or home-office and only visible in Avvo/Justia/FindLaw, which were blocked to direct fetch here.

Physicians / medical - thin beyond three solo practices plus a walk-in clinic. Manville's biggest medical presence is Summit Medical Group (a large system, excluded by rule), and hospital-affiliated practices were not chased.
Veterinarians - none with a Manville address. The vets serving Manville (All Pets, Branchburg; Somerset Veterinary Group, Bridgewater) sit outside the zone and were excluded.

Title / appraisal / surveying / engineering / architecture - nothing found. These are county-wide firms with no Manville storefront and no chamber listing for the borough (Manville has no active Chamber of Commerce).

Independent hotels, event venues and photographers - nothing with a Manville address beyond party rentals; the borough's gathering spaces are churches, the VFW/American Legion halls and the library, all excluded.
Insurance agencies - only three independent agencies found; several Manville insurance offices are branded franchise agencies (State Farm, Primerica, Allstate) which the rules exclude.
Retail - thin but not empty (hardware, two florists, furniture/mattress, consignment, clock shop). Manville's Main Street retail is mostly food, pharmacy and dollar/discount chains, all excluded.
caveats: Zone geometry: Manville borough centre is roughly 9.9 miles straight-line from central Milltown (40.4498, -74.4407); the southern edge of the borough is about 9.3-9.5 miles and the northern edge about 10.5-10.6 miles. Roughly the northern third of the borough - N Main St above the downtown, N 8th to N 13th Aves, Dukes Pkwy, Dominic St, Roosevelt Ave and the far north end of Brooks Blvd - is at or just beyond the 10-mile line. All Manville-address businesses are listed; the far-north ones are flagged in their notes. Distances are estimates from street geometry, not per-address geocoding.
Entries labelled 'one directory only' come from the municipal self-registration list, which can contain lapsed or home-based businesses. The triage team should confirm each one.

Borough directory listings that point at a wrong or unrelated website (Advo-Serv, Landstar Contracting, Hua Hua Massage, World Taxes, Manville Maytag Repair) have the website field left blank rather than repeating a bad link.

Eight names could not be typed at all (4d Limited, For My Good Work, Sin Communications, J C Enterprises, Lj' Z Boardwalk, Pure Go Go, Triple B Service, Saddle Up Car Services). They are included with a name-only category and flagged rather than dropped, because completeness was prioritised.

A2Z Dental Care, C&S Construction, OTX Home Remodeling, JLG Printing, Landview Landscape, Rapid Fire Security, Badri Transportation, G Transline and Landstar have no street address in the sources; address recorded as Unknown rather than guessed.

Excluded by rule and deliberately not listed: all restaurants/food (including Manville Pizza, Frank's, Tierra Del Sol/Pura Vida Ticos, Elite Poke Box, Manville Pastry, J&L Bakery), pharmacies (CVS, Easy Pharmacy), grocery/convenience/liquor, banks and credit unions (Fulton, Somerset Savings, Manville Area FCU), places of worship, the library, USPS, volunteer fire company, American Legion/VFW and bowling association, Summit Medical Group, and chains/franchises (Walmart, Advance Auto, GNC, Great Clips, Boost, Leslie's, Compass Self Storage, Reading Cinemas, U-Haul, Dunkin, McDonald's, Popeyes, Subway, Quickchek, Royal Farms, Conoco, Express Fuel, Jackson Hewitt, One Dollar Zone, Seal Master, Signarama, Dollar Tree).
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API timed out from this environment (both via fetch and the browser HTTP client); OSM coverage of Manville was not used.

YellowPages, Justia, Avvo, FindLaw, BBB category pages and hub.biz returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so those sources were used only through search-result snippets and their category coverage is partial.

Google Maps in the browser returned only about five results per query and would not paginate, so map-based category sweeps (the best way to catch businesses missing from the borough directory) are incomplete.
The borough business directory paginates by form postback; the full list was only obtainable through its ysnShowAll=1 view, and that list may lag actual openings and closures.

Manville has no active Chamber of Commerce (per a 2023 mayoral address), so there is no member directory to cross-check; the Somerset County Business Partnership member finder could not be filtered to Manville.

No phone or address was guessed. Where directories disagree (Durkast, Gary Weber Plumbing, Otrimski, Educated Touch, Deep Sea Facial Spa, Main Street Dance) both versions are noted for the triage call.
A Primerica representative office at 113R S Main St (908-300-8252) was excluded as a branded franchise agency per the rules; flag it if the owner wants branded agencies included after all.
